{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Perché non sei passat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} a trovarmi?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Whoops!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} I hate to do this to you,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
but something has come up.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}We're going to have to postpone
this little adventure for a while.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} {{TAG:0003:0027:}}Will
you take a rain check?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Ay, flor...{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Siento de veras hacerte
esto, pero me ha surgido un
contratiempo.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Tendremos que posponer tu visita
para otro día.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Perdona!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Crois bien que j'en suis navrée,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}
mais un imprévu fait que je dois
remettre notre entrevue à plus tard.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}J'en suis désolée, {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}vraiment. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Ce n'est
pas dans mes habitudes, je t'assure.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Oje, oje!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich tue dies nur äußerst
ungern,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}aber ich muss unser Treffen
leider verschieben.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich hoffe, wir finden bald einen
geeigneten Zeitpunkt, um es
nachzuholen!

ama bir şey çıktı.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Bu küçük macerayı

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Sorry,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}I know I invited
you over to my place and then I
didn't show up on time.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I have a perfectly reasonable
explanation{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}that I am unfortunately
unable to share with you right now.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Yes,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'm being mysterious. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}No,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I
won't clarify anything. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Ha!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} That's

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}¡Siento no haber estado en casa a
la hora acordada!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿Estuviste
esperando mucho rato?
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Tuve que ocuparme de un asunto
urgente y no pude avisarte,
perdona.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}No te importa quedar otro día,
¿verdad?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Je suis vraiment navrée,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Je sais que c'est pourtant moi qui
t'avais demandé de venir...
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mais il y a une bonne raison au fait
que je t'ai posé un lapin.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Même si je ne m'en souviens plus
pour le moment{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Ne t'inquiète pas,{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} je te la donnerai
dès que je m'en souviendrai.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Tut mir leid,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich habe
dich zu mir eingeladen und bin dann
nicht rechtzeitig zu Hause gewesen.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Es gibt einen triftigen Grund dafür{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
den ich dir leider aus Gründen der
Geheimhaltung verschweigen muss!
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Die mysteriöse Aura gehört
schließlich zu meinem Image!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Üzgünüm,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Seni evime davet
edip sonra zamanında
gelemediğimi biliyorum.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bunun son derece makul bir açıklaması
var{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}ama ne yazık ki şu an
seninle paylaşamam.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Evet,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} gizemli davranıyorum. {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Hayır,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
hiçbir şeyi açıklığa kavuşturmayacağım.
{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Ha!{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Beni bunun için
seviyorsun,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} değil mi?
